scope: Foreground paired-AMP baseline suite; no historical model changes
checks: official MMDetection three-config load and adaptation
dataset source preservation and class mapping
local_runtime: Python 3.9.13; Torch 2.8 CPU; lightweight config-only MMEngine/MMDetection dependencies isolated in workspace
important_contracts: AMP0/AMP1 pairs use identical recipes except precision; no automatic batch/AMP fallback
Official RF-DETR 1.4 AMP is BF16, YOLO and MMDetection AMP are FP16
RF-DETR derived labels are zero-based; common COCO labels are one-based
RF-DETR input 624 keeps native positional parameter grid 26 and uses upstream interpolation
RF-DETR test loader requires real held-out test, but run_test is false
No source dataset or completed result overwritten
Full GPU correctness, performance and dependency installation still require server preflight and 1-3 epoch smoke
